description: This file defines a React component named 'Cell' that represents an individual cell in a Tic Tac Toe game grid. It manages rendering a styled button that displays a player's mark ('X' or 'O') or remains empty, handling click interactions, and applying conditional styles based on the cell's state and theme.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: React functional component that renders a styled button representing a Tic Tac Toe cell with properties for index, value, disabled state, and click handler.
